en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a large hilltop castle complex above dense trees. The building features several massive round towers, one with an onion-shaped dome, steep gabled roofs with dormer windows, and two tall, slender church-like towers with cupolas in the background. The architecture is late-medieval/early Renaissance Central European. No text or caption is visible on the image.
